description: Commodities Orderbook Realtime Demo with Arrays

panels.description: Contango/backwardation basis: front month mid-price minus deferred month mid-price for WTI Crude (CL vs CL12) and Natural Gas (NG vs NG12). Positive = backwardation (front premium), negative = contango (deferred premium).

targets.rawSql:
WITH cl AS (
  SELECT timestamp, (best_bid + best_ask)/2 as mid
  FROM commodities_bbo_1s
  WHERE symbol = 'CL' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
), cl12 AS (
  SELECT timestamp, (best_bid + best_ask)/2 as mid
  FROM commodities_bbo_1s
  WHERE symbol = 'CL12' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
)
SELECT cl.timestamp as time, cl.mid - cl12.mid as CL_basis
FROM cl ASOF JOIN cl12

WITH ng AS (
  SELECT timestamp, (best_bid + best_ask)/2 as mid
  FROM commodities_bbo_1s
  WHERE symbol = 'NG' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
), ng12 AS (
  SELECT timestamp, (best_bid + best_ask)/2 as mid
  FROM commodities_bbo_1s
  WHERE symbol = 'NG12' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
)
SELECT ng.timestamp as time, ng.mid - ng12.mid as NG_basis
FROM ng ASOF JOIN ng12

panels.description: Live price movers across all commodities. Shows current mid-price and percentage change over 10s, 1m, and 5m horizons. Gauge bars and color coding update on every refresh.

targets.rawSql:
WITH now_price AS (
  SELECT symbol, commodity_class, (best_bid + best_ask)/2 as mid
  FROM commodities_market_data
  WHERE timestamp > dateadd('s', -5, now())
  LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY symbol
), ago_10s AS (
  SELECT symbol, (best_bid + best_ask)/2 as mid
  FROM commodities_market_data
  WHERE timestamp > dateadd('s', -15, now()) AND timestamp < dateadd('s', -8, now())
  LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY symbol
), ago_1m AS (
  SELECT symbol, (best_bid + best_ask)/2 as mid
  FROM commodities_market_data
  WHERE timestamp > dateadd('m', -2, now()) AND timestamp < dateadd('s', -55, now())
  LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY symbol
), ago_5m AS (
  SELECT symbol, (best_bid + best_ask)/2 as mid
  FROM commodities_market_data
  WHERE timestamp > dateadd('m', -6, now()) AND timestamp < dateadd('m', -4, now())
  LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY symbol
)
SELECT n.symbol, n.commodity_class as class, n.mid,
  (n.mid - t.mid) / t.mid * 100 as chg_10s,
  (n.mid - m.mid) / m.mid * 100 as chg_1m,
  (n.mid - f.mid) / f.mid * 100 as chg_5m
FROM now_price n
LEFT JOIN ago_10s t ON n.symbol = t.symbol
LEFT JOIN ago_1m m ON n.symbol = m.symbol
LEFT JOIN ago_5m f ON n.symbol = f.symbol
ORDER BY abs((n.mid - t.mid) / t.mid) DESC

panels.description: Visualizes the order book snapshot for the selected commodity, showing the price and cumulative volume at each bid and ask level. The area under the green (bids) and red (asks) lines represents market liquidity on both sides, with the mid-price and top volume walls highlighted.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snapshot AS (
  SELECT timestamp, bids, asks
  FROM commodities_market_data
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND symbol = '${SYMBOL}'
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT timestamp, bids[1] as bprices, bids[2] as bvolumes, array_cum_sum(bids[2]) as bcumvolumes, asks[1] as aprices, asks[2] as avolumes, array_cum_sum(asks[2]) as acumvolumes FROM snapshot;

panels.title: Market Depth - ${SYMBOL}

panels.description: Rolling table of the most recent seconds for the selected commodity, showing the current average spread and aggregated bid/ask volumes in lots.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp as Time, avg(best_ask - best_bid) as Spread, sum(bids[2,1]) as Bid_Volume, sum(asks[2,1]) as Ask_Volume
FROM commodities_market_data
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND symbol = '${SYMBOL}'
SAMPLE BY 1s
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 6

panels.title: Spread and Volume per second - ${SYMBOL}

panels.description: Pairs each recent trade with the most recent order book snapshot via ASOF JOIN, showing trade execution quality: slippage in basis points relative to the mid-price, and whether the trade was inside or outside the spread.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.timestamp as Time, t.side as Side, t.price as Trade_Price, t.size as Size,
  m.best_bid as Bid, m.best_ask as Ask,
  (m.best_bid + m.best_ask)/2 as Mid,
  CASE t.side
    WHEN 'B' THEN (t.price - (m.best_bid + m.best_ask)/2) / ((m.best_bid + m.best_ask)/2) * 10000
    WHEN 'S' THEN ((m.best_bid + m.best_ask)/2 - t.price) / ((m.best_bid + m.best_ask)/2) * 10000
  END as Slippage_BPS
FROM commodities_trades t
ASOF JOIN commodities_market_data m ON (symbol)
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.timestamp) AND t.symbol = '${SYMBOL}'
ORDER BY t.timestamp DESC
LIMIT 8

panels.title: Trade Execution vs Orderbook - ${SYMBOL}

panels.description: Candlestick chart of the best bid from the order book, aggregated into 1-second intervals with volume.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp, first(bids[1,1]) open, max(bids[1,1]) high,
min(bids[1,1]) low, last(bids[1,1]) close, sum(bids[2,1]) total_volume
FROM commodities_market_data
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND symbol = '${SYMBOL}'
SAMPLE BY 1s

WITH sampled AS (
  SELECT timestamp,
    last(bids[1,1]) as price,
    sum(bids[2,1]) as vol
  FROM commodities_market_data
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND symbol = '${SYMBOL}'
  SAMPLE BY 1s
)
SELECT timestamp,
  SUM(price * vol) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) /
  SUM(vol) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS VWAP
FROM sampled

panels.title: OHLC - Bids - 1s - (${SYMBOL})

panels.description: Multi-layered chart combining VWAP, RSI (12h), and Bollinger Bands (20,2) overlaid on OHLC candles from the trades table. Each Bollinger period is 15 minutes, so the SMA covers a 5-hour window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sampled AS (
    SELECT timestamp, symbol, volume,
          ((open+close)/2) * volume AS traded_value
    FROM commodities_trades_ohlcv_1m
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND symbol IN '${SYMBOL}'
), cumulative AS (
    SELECT timestamp, symbol,
          SUM(traded_value) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS cumulative_value,
          SUM(volume) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS cumulative_volume
    FROM sampled
)
SELECT timestamp, cumulative_value/cumulative_volume AS vwap FROM cumulative

SELECT timestamp, open, high, low, close, volume
FROM commodities_trades_ohlcv_15m
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND symbol = '${SYMBOL}'

WITH price_changes AS (
    SELECT timestamp, symbol, max_bid,
        max_bid - prev_bid price_change
    FROM (
      SELECT timestamp, symbol, max_bid,
          LAG(max_bid) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY timestamp) AS prev_bid
      FROM commodities_bbo_1h
      WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND symbol = '${SYMBOL}'
    )
),
gains_losses AS (
    SELECT timestamp, symbol, max_bid,
        CASE WHEN price_change > 0 THEN price_change ELSE 0 END AS gain,
        CASE WHEN price_change < 0 THEN ABS(price_change) ELSE 0 END AS loss
    FROM price_changes
),
avg_gains_losses AS (
    SELECT timestamp, symbol, max_bid,
        AVG(gain) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_gain,
        AVG(loss) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_loss
    FROM gains_losses
)
SELECT timestamp, max_bid as Bid,
    CASE
        WHEN avg_loss = 0 THEN 100
        ELSE 100 - (100 / (1 + (avg_gain / NULLIF(avg_loss, 0))))
    END AS RSI_12h
FROM avg_gains_losses
ORDER BY timestamp

WITH stats AS (
  SELECT timestamp, close,
    AVG(close) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sma20,
    AVG(close * close) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_close_sq
  FROM commodities_trades_ohlcv_15m
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND symbol IN '${SYMBOL}'
)
SELECT timestamp, sma20,
  sma20 + 2 * sqrt(avg_close_sq - (sma20 * sma20)) as upper_band,
  sma20 - 2 * sqrt(avg_close_sq - (sma20 * sma20)) as lower_band
FROM stats
ORDER BY timestamp

FROM commodities_market_data
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND symbol IN '${SYMBOL}'
SAMPLE BY 30s
